No contract was formed by the exchanged writings alone. Costco's "conditional upon" response is most likely a counteroffer under UCC § 2-207(1), so a contract would arise only from later conduct, on the $1,000 terms without the loading charge. The team note is wrong: § 2-207(2) does not automatically make an added term part of a merchant contract, and a material alteration like a $50-per-thousand charge would be excluded even if the acceptance were treated as valid. If a court reads "conditional upon" as not expressly conditional, the result would instead be a contract on the $1,000 terms, again without the charge.

CONFIDENCE: 58
